evals.prompt: I want to start doing double-entry bookkeeping for my personal finances. Can you find some good GitHub projects that could help?

assertions.name: includes_major_projects
assertions.description: Report includes at least 2 of the major bookkeeping projects (beancount, ledger, hledger)

assertions.name: includes_star_counts
assertions.description: Each recommended repository includes its star count

assertions.name: includes_direct_links
assertions.description: Each repository has a clickable GitHub URL

assertions.name: explains_relevance
assertions.description: Report explains why each tool is relevant to personal finance bookkeeping

evals.prompt: I'd like to run large language models locally on my machine. What are some good open source options on GitHub?

assertions.name: includes_major_projects
assertions.description: Report includes major local LLM projects (ollama, llama.cpp, vllm, gpt4all)

assertions.name: includes_star_counts
assertions.description: Each recommended repository includes its star count

assertions.name: includes_direct_links
assertions.description: Each repository has a clickable GitHub URL

assertions.name: provides_comparison
assertions.description: Report helps user choose between different tools based on use case

evals.prompt: I'm setting up a new dev environment and want to manage my dotfiles properly. Find me some popular approaches or tools on GitHub.

assertions.name: includes_management_tools
assertions.description: Report includes at least 2 dotfiles management tools (chezmoi, dotbot, stow, etc.)

assertions.name: includes_reference_examples
assertions.description: Report includes example dotfiles repositories to learn from

assertions.name: provides_comparison
assertions.description: Report helps user choose between different approaches

assertions.name: includes_beginner_guidance
assertions.description: Report provides getting started guidance for beginners
